notes.title: Big announcements for Goblinz 5th Anniversary!
notes.content:

Today is a special day for Goblinz, as the studio is already celebrating its 5th anniversary!
For the past 5 years, we have been developing and publishing games we believe in. It's been quite an adventure, but this is just the beginning!

For the occasion, we have surprises for you including new games announcement and big sales on all our games!

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/publisher/goblinz_publishing/sale/publishersale][img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/33904811/031edc7df8b0e2ab9136d7024a38b2fa14a2f260.png[/img][/url]

[b]Diluvian Winds[/b] is a [b]sail punk city builder[/b] developed by [b]Alambik Studio[/b].
In a context of exile due to the rising waters, survive as you expand your community in your lighthouse!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1561040/Diluvian_Winds/

notes.title: A Long Way Down is OUT!
notes.content:
Hi everyone!

Goblinz Studio and Seenapsis are proud to announce that:
[h1][url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/856990]A Long Way Down is available in Early Access![/url][/h1]

https://store.steampowered.com/app/856990

If you like deck-building and roguelite RPGs, if you like challenging card games and dark universes, this game is for you! Assemble your party and use your cards to survive, fight and build your way through a dark maze of monsters orchestrated by an evil mastermind.

[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/856990][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33025551/e64e11fdd8d20a1582044645c600633e4ef2d0bb.gif[/img][/url]

The worlds of the afterlife have opened their gates. You'll need a sword and a deck of cards to get through them!
Each world has its own enemies, allies, obstacles and treasures. Here is a small glimpse of what awaits you in the first two universes, available in the Early Access:

The first world you'll discover is Damballa’s Chamber. A voodoo spirit of fertility and goodness, Damballa is the guardian of occult knowledge.
A ruined kingdom, mythological monsters, weird tombs, servants turned into grave sculptures. Which evil spirit perverted this place?
[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/856990][img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33025551/f0ed2496dd9cf41fe5b5cbd6928fac50ae641542.gif[/img][/url]

In the second world, you are embarked in the swamps of the bayou. Marinette was a cruel woman and a powerful witch. Her occult ceremonies were the setting for human sacrifices.

Beware, for her lair is now inhabited by their wandering souls!

Will you go far enough to unlock the third world?
More will be available at the next update, stay tuned!

Join the Discord: [url=https://discord.gg/7uhURkS]here![/url]

notes.title: As Far As The Eye (Unexpected) is now published by Goblinz Studio
notes.content:
Goblinz Studio is publishing As Far As The Eye, a game developed by Unexpected.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1119700/As_Far_As_The_Eye/

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33025551/c7fb2a1041c712a25ecc92433217108d83a11401.png[/img]

[h1]When great minds meet[/h1]

We met the Unexpected team during Paris Games Week and immediately saw the potential of the game. The team needed a few months to make it even better and stronger. We felt our expertise in making witty, community-centric games could fit very well with their project.

Goblinz and Unexpected have the same ideals: We believe that this industry needs more games about living in harmony with nature, about non-violence. We want games that help you think and understand new dynamics with an ecological mindset. A FATE is totally that, a game where you’re nature’s friend and co-exist with it peacefully.

Check A FATE steam page to get more details about the game and wishlist it!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1119700/As_Far_As_The_Eye/

[img]https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/33025551/da848b6b6fef9ba46b07123855589e14c34451ba.png[/img]

[h1]
Goblinz Plans[/h1]

We now manage 5 upcoming games you can find on our Publisher Page [link]. We try to support every game the same. We’re dedicated to produce them with a fair consideration to team situations. We give them all the best chance of success!

Noticeably, we’ve added a few months of production to A Long Way Down to increase quality. Snowtopia is on a good track to be a great game that gets regular updates. Iris And The Giant gets a Unity port to improve future plans. Legend of Keepers reached a 95% positive review and Top 4 free games on Steam for October.

A new game means some changes in the organization, and a team update! Carla will be joining us a QA Manager. She will help us test thoroughly the game, record screenshots and gifs for social media. Welcome her kindly!

Cheers,
Goblinz.

notes.title: Robothorium announced!
notes.content:
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/657090/Robothorium/][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11383890/024d47ef174743c80321b216ba89c47e408ea9b2.jpg[/img][/url]
[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/657090/Robothorium/] [U][B]ADD TO WISHLIST[/B][/U] [/url]

We are happy to announce our next game, Robothorium! 

It's a turn-based RPG with random generated levels. Every choice you make will have impact on exploration and story!

[B][U]Synopsis[/U][/B]
2052. Planet Earth. BreakTech, an enterprise specialised in robotic construction, is flourishing thanks to thorium, an unlimited and innovative power source. After many years of exploitation, robots are finally protesting for their rights. But the peaceful movement is quickly escalating to riots and the human repression is near. Now seen as a first degree threat, robots are hunted down and culled throughout the planet. You, S.I.A, an enhanced artificial intelligence, have to end this surrounding chaos and build a future for your robots. Unite with the new rebel factions, which have been engaged in turf war for months, then deal with cyborgs, humans and robots to lead your own robotic uprising.

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/657090/Robothorium/][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11383890/c68ce66d4dcee5f5458991f620655fb12f58f445.png[/img][/url]

[B][U]Gameplay:[/U][/B]
Play an AI to lead your own robotic uprising and deploy your robots in many places from factories to highly secured laboratories with different objectives to achieve. Select the best robots combination to succeed in your missions and to overcome traps and enemies guarding experimental projects or top secret datas.

[url=http://store.steampowered.com/app/657090/Robothorium/][img]http://cdn.edgecast.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11383890/f1d21ec151358509f01fada05141f0a2196039ab.jpg[/img][/url]

notes.title: Version 1.2.0: Neverending Tower

We have worked hard to enhance the game experience based on your feedbacks and reports. This patch note contains a brand new game mode, characters balance, skins available as a DLC as well as some modifications to make the Arena mode more attractive and Portuguese localization!

You can find a Deluxe Edition bundle containing the Soundtrack, Wallpapers and the Skins pack [url=http://store.steampowered.com/bundle/2403/]here[/url] with -15% off if you already own the game!

[list]

[*] New Steam leaderboards for the Neverending Tower feature!
[*] New pack containing 1 skin for each playable character available as a DLC!
[*] You can now share your exploration replay on social networks!
[*] Portuguese localization is now available!
[/list]

[list]
[*] Dungeon limits have been increased for Arena mode to make multiplayer dungeons more difficult
[*] Matchmaking has been improved by increasing the points range when looking for an opponent. Players will now be able to face opponents from a higher or lower league if an opponent of the same league can’t be found
[*] ELO system for Arena mode has been reworked: Losing a match will now give points to the defending player and the attacking player will lose points as usual. Winning a match will now make the defending player lose points and the attacking player will win points as usual. The number of points won or lost are now depending on the difference of points between the two players 
[*] Skeleton Warriors’ experience earned when killed has been increased
[/list]

[list] 
[*] Pod:

[list]
[*] Shrilling Threnody base damage has been reduced from 1 to 0

[*] A stamina cost increase of 1 has been added to the Lullaby talent
[*] Spiritual Ballad base mana regen has been reduced from 25% to 20%
[*] Mana regen bonus granted by the Spiritual Ballad talent has been reduced from +25% to +20%
[/list]

[list]
[*] Laceration damage scaling with strength has been increased
[*] Laceration base damage has been increased from 0 to 1

[*] Explosive Potion damage scaling with magical power has been slightly increased
[*] Explosive Potion base chance to apply Burn has been increased from 15% to 20%
[*] Bonus chance to apply Burn from the Explosive Potion talent has been increased from +15% to +20% per level
[*] Orc Curse is now dealing small damage in addition to its previous effects
[*] Additional mana cost from the Orc Curse talent which allows the skill to target all enemies instead of a line has been increased from 1 to 2
[*] Bait base stamina cost has been reduced from 5 to 4
[/list]

[*] Rose:

[list]
[*] Disease base damage per turn has been increased from 1 to 2
[*] Disease base duration has been reduced from 3 to 2 turns
[/list]

[*] Odessa:

[list]
[*] War Cry base stamina cost has been reduced from 5 to 4
[/list]

[*] Franck:

[list]
[*] Shoots damage are now physical damage and are scaling with strength
[*] Shoots can now be launched on a line of your choice instead of the front line only
[*] Armor and magical resistance from the talent which grants bonuses when a mojo is equipped have been increased from 3 to 5
[*] The talent granting a magical power bonus when using Nature Boon is now granting a strength bonus instead
[*] Mana burst bonus from the Dual Claw talent has been increased from 3 to 4
[*] Chances to apply Poison from Creepers Prison talent has been increased from 25% to 35% per level
[*] Passive mana regen from the passive ability Shapeshifter: Human has been increased from 2 to 3
[*] Passive damage bonus from the passive ability Shapeshifter: Beast has been increased from +15% to +20%
[/list]
		
[*] Anemhutep:

[list]
[*] Soul Absorption base life cost has been reduced from 3 to 1
[*] Strips Explosion base life cost has been reduced from 4 to 3
[*] Mummified base magical resistance debuff has been increased from 10% to 15%
[*] Magical resistance debuff bonus from the Mummified talent has been increased from -10% to -15%
[*] Life Drain life regen per turn has been increased from 2 to 3 at max level
[/list]

[/list]

[H1] Bugfixing [/H1]
[list]
[*] Fixed a bug where pressing U in a free dungeon were opening a window
[*] Fixed a bug that were preventing the last tab to display all recipes available in the Workshop
[*] Fixed a bug preventing the right click to display a fighter’s details in fight
[*] Fixed a bug when failing to find an opponent in arena that made the player go on the profile screen

notes.title: Release version 1.0.0 is available!
notes.content:
[img]http://dungeon-rushers.com/steam_headers/version_v1.0.0.png[/img]

[H1] Features [/H1]
[list]
[*] Last but not least, the 4th theme is now available with around 7 hours of additional gameplay in the desert!

[img]http://dungeon-rushers.com/steam_screens/1.0.0/campaign.png[/img]

[*] New characters to unlock: Anemhutep the Ancient Mummy Dude and Elvire the Crusader of the Light Temple!
[*] As well as 8 new monsters and an unexpected final Boss!

[img]http://dungeon-rushers.com/steam_screens/1.0.0/anem.png[/img]
[img]http://dungeon-rushers.com/steam_screens/1.0.0/elvire.png[/img]
[img]http://dungeon-rushers.com/steam_screens/1.0.0/monsters.png[/img]

[*] New fight event: Sand storm - Fighters take small damage at the end of the turn. Each negative effect increases damage taken!

[img]http://dungeon-rushers.com/steam_screens/1.0.0/sand storm.png[/img]

[*] New exploration mechanism: Portals - Where will you be teleported in the dungeon? Who knows...
[*] New Free Mode Dungeon tools: Doors requiring 2 and 3 keys, Magic door requiring a password and Portals!

[img]http://dungeon-rushers.com/steam_screens/1.0.0/Portals.png[/img]
[img]http://dungeon-rushers.com/steam_screens/1.0.0/Doors.png[/img]

[*] 4 new Heroic only items!
[*] Translation in German and Chinese are now available! (Russian and Japanese translations are already in process)
[/list]

[H1] Improvements [/H1]
[list]
	[*] New font: easier for your eyes to read our humorous story!
[*] Introduction text for each theme has now a displaying animation
	[*] Many UI improvements
	[*] Sounds added for Rose
	[*] Sounds for theme 3 monsters added
	[*] Lots of sounds added for effects and exploration
	[*] Sounds has been equalized and rebalanced with music volume

[/list]

notes.content:
[img]http://dungeon-rushers.com/steam_headers/version_v0.9.3.png[/img]

[H1] Features [/H1]
[list]
[*] End of theme 3 is now available
[*] New Heroic-only items added for theme 3
[*] New fight event: Camouflage - Monsters are hidden in a strange bush, if you want to know what is hiding in it, you’ll have to hit the bush or wait for something to come out of it!
[img]http://dungeon-rushers.com/steam_screens/bush_screen.png[/img]

[list]
[*] Items in the inventory are now sorted in addition to the filter
[*] Moving away from a wooden sign in a dungeon will now close it automatically
[*] Beeing Game Over during a fight will now refresh the shop
[*] Talents’ tooltip has been improved to better understand what will be increased when putting a second talent point
[*] Collapse fight event now have a sound and has a better timing
[*] More balancing changes have been made to characters and monsters 
[*] New tutorial page when you first level up
[*] Fight tutorial has been changed to inform players about the characters or monsters details window appearing by right clicking on a fighter
[*] Some dungeons has been made optional in theme 2 and 3 to smoothen the player progression and allow the story to progress faster
[*] Facebook and Twitter buttons added to the menu screen
[*] New animation for monsters summoned
[*] Animation of monsters coming for reinforcement has been reworked
[/list]

[H1] Bugfixing [/H1]
[list]
[*] Pressing two or more shortcuts buttons/mouse clicks at the same time no longer make the game glitch
[*] The dungeon validation bug caused by the “Only one boss” restriction has been fixed
[*] Channeling bugs should now be fixed for monsters concerned
[*] The reinforcement skills “Pygmies!!!” and “Help me!” bug has been fixed and should no longer call for unintended monsters
[*] Fixed a bug in the shop where you were blocked on your inventory second page if you sold the last item of the page
[*] Deleting a tile in the dungeon editor should now also delete the token displayed in it if it was the case
[*] Fixed a bug in fight where monsters’ life bar was not refreshed correctly
[*] Fixed a bug in fight where characters' life bar was not refreshed correctly when healed when attacking (Vampirism effect or Melinda’s Blood Drinker ability)
[*] Fixed a bug in fight where damage previews were not taking count of damage amplifiers like the Stalked effect from Melinda
[/list]

notes.title: Beta 0.8.3 available!
notes.content:
[img]http://dungeon-rushers.com/steam_headers/beta_v0.8.3.png[/img]
[url=http://dungeon-rushers.com/#preorder] [U] BETA ACCESS HERE[/U] [/url]

Sorry for the late update, we worked hard on a lot of features and we opened the theme 2 to all beta testers!

[H1] Features [/H1]
[list]
[*] Now possible to change resolution and fullscreen mode
[*] New tooltip in exploration to quickly check your team life, mana and stamina
[*] New dialog system in fight to replace tutorials
[*] Fight : effect informations are now available in spell tooltip
[*] New campaign UI with a bigger map, dynamic buttons and dungeons idle
[*] New wonderful treasure and gems animation at the end of a dungeon
[*] New dungeon creation system
[*] New buffs and debuffs with new icons
	[*] New animations on tiles when using an ability on traps or monsters
	[*] New themes for manors view changed dynamically
	[*] Add tavern in the game, to see your friends
[/list]

[H1] Improvements [/H1]
[list]
	[*] Camera auto-center in exploration is now smoother
[*] Camera is now auto-centered on a tile before launching an ability animation	
[*] Increased movement speed in exploration
	[*] New buff and debuff animations
	[*] New, longer animations for Pod
	[*] New animations for Gobelin chief boss
	[*] New flash on Thor Hit thunder animation for Thorgrim
	[*] Thorgrim’s Trombe animation is now visually hitting mobs
	[*] Many animations reworked or improved
	[*] Better hitted timing in fight
	[*] Better colors for critical hits, parries and heals display
	[*] New hitted sound for magic skills	
	[*] New sound for crossbow and traps arrow shoots
	[*] New sound for Pod Silence skill
[*] Game Over screen now have music
[*] Many sounds reworked
	[*] Players will now drop more ore to be able to craft
	[*] Level required is now displayed in red when a character can’t use it
[/list]

[H1] Bugfixing [/H1]
[list]
[*] Crafting an item gives less exp in each job
[*] Effects are now lost when a monster is resurrected
[*] Activating an ability on a trap or triggering the trap should no longer produce the click holding bug
[*] Dialogue sound is now lower
[*] Game Over screen now stay displayed with music until mouse or button clicked
[*] Fix tooltips which stay openned when you close a window

[/list]
